# 📋 Use camp shower

- **Checklist types:** Shower
- **Area:** Private infrastructure
- **Why:** Potable water and gray-water capacity are limited.
- **When:** Every time a camp member uses the shower
- **Time:** 3 minutes or less of running water

## What you need

- 🔧 Camp Shower — Shower area (see the map). Private shower for Treble Makers camp members only.
- 🔧 Gray-Water Pump — Shower area. Pump that moves shower water into the camp gray-water system.
- 🔧 Out of Service Sign — Private infrastructure area. Reusable sign used to close unsafe or nonfunctional camp equipment.
- 📦 Trash Bins
- A personal bag
- A timer

## Ready before normal use

- **🔧 Camp Shower:** The shower is open, clean, empty of personal belongings, and has no leak or standing water.
- **🔧 Gray-Water Pump:** The pump is available and removes water from the shower basin.
- **📦 Trash Bins:** Not full.

## Steps

1. Brush loose hair before entering 🔧 Camp Shower.
2. Put clothes, bottles, packaging, and personal items in your bag.
3. Start the timer when you turn on the water.
4. Turn off the water while applying soap or shampoo.
5. Rinse your body.
6. Direct rinse water over soap remaining on the walls and floor.
7. Turn off the water before the timer reaches 3 minutes.
8. Put hair, wipes, razors, and packaging in 📦 Trash Bins.
9. Run 🔧 Gray-Water Pump until the shower basin is empty.
   - **IF/THEN:** IF the pump does not remove the water or you see a leak, THEN close the shower, display 🔧 Out of Service Sign, and tell the Dominatrix.

## PASS when

- Running-water time did not exceed 3 minutes.
- No personal item, hair, trash, mud, or standing water remains.
- No water reached the playa.

## Finish

- Before marking PASS, return each used item to its location and leave it ready for the next person.
- Collect all MOOP.
- If an item, instruction, or solution is missing or unclear, ask the Dominatrix.

### Leave items ready

- **🔧 Camp Shower:** No personal belonging, hair, trash, mud, visible dirt, leak, puddle, or standing water remains.
- **🔧 Gray-Water Pump:** The pump is off after the shower basin is empty. No hose or connection leaks.
- **🔧 Out of Service Sign:** The sign is displayed on closed equipment or returned to its storage place.
- **📦 Trash Bins:** A trash bag is installed and is not full. No loose trash is present around the bins.

### If an item is not ready

- **🔧 Camp Shower:** Close the shower, display 🔧 Out of Service Sign, and tell the Dominatrix.
- **🔧 Gray-Water Pump:** Close the shower, display 🔧 Out of Service Sign, and tell the Dominatrix.
- **📦 Trash Bins:** If the trash bag is full, tie the bag closed and take the bag to the dumpster. Ask the Dominatrix where to get a replacement trash bag. Install the replacement bag.

## Who to ask

Dominatrix
